memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Balaam answered Balak, "Did I not tell the messengers you sent me, 'Even if Balak gave me all the silver and gold in his palace, I could not do anything of my own accord, good or bad, to go beyond the command of the LORD—and I must say only what the LORD says'?" - Num 24:12-13 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Balaam defends himself by reminding Balak of what he had said all along: even a palace full of silver and gold could not make him go beyond God's command. He could not speak of his own accord, whether good or bad. He was bound to say only what the Lord gave him to say.

There is truth in these words, even coming from a compromised man. When God has spoken, no amount of wealth or pressure can rightly change the message. God's word is not for sale, and His purposes are not up for negotiation. Balaam, for all his failings, grasped this much clearly.

Yet we should hold this alongside the fuller picture Scripture gives of Balaam. Elsewhere he is remembered not as a hero but as a warning, a man who loved the wages of wickedness (2 Pet 2:15). He spoke God's true words while his heart still leaned toward the reward. Right words do not always come from a right heart.

This sobers us. It is possible to say true things about God while our hearts remain unsurrendered. What God desires is not merely correct speech but a heart wholly devoted to Him. In Christ we are called to more than accurate words; we are called to love God with all our heart (Mark 12:30). Let your words and your heart be united in true devotion.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Can you say true things about God while your heart remains divided?
2. What does it mean to serve God with your heart, not just your words?
3. Where might God be calling you to fuller surrender?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, I do not want merely to speak rightly about You while my heart wanders. Unite my words and my heart in true devotion, that I may love You with all that I am. Amen.
